decision: Does exact bounded uniform-observed-shield target/behavior weighting correct the L2f logged-action-measure mismatch while retaining a calibrated, episode-stable current-root action increment on low-propensity, known-nonbaseline, and pre-first-HIT rows?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.candidate_probability_surface: full candidate raw clipped fraction is at most 0.001; comparator clipping is reported but is not a candidate rejection
gate.importance_weight_contract: all weights are finite, positive, at most five, and exact under the declared 80 percent baseline plus 20 percent uniform collector
gate.incremental_action_signal: uniform-target complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for weighted full minus weighted state-only Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.low_propensity_action_signal: behavior-propensity-below-0.025 rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions
gate.nonbaseline_action_signal: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions
gate.uniform_target_model_gain: uniform-target complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for weighted full minus frozen unweighted L2f full Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions

hypotheses.H1_target_measure: If L2f failed because unweighted fitting projects the hazard under a baseline-heavy action measure, bounded uniform-shield target weighting will improve target-weighted Brier over the frozen unweighted L2f full model.
hypotheses.H2_action_increment: If the current-root action-relative facts identify portable physical risk under exploration support, weighted full will beat weighted state-only overall, on known-nonbaseline rows, and in the below-0.025 propensity bulk.
hypotheses.H3_lifecycle: The weighted full-versus-state increment remains episode-stable before the first physical HIT rather than relying on post-HIT lifecycle state.
hypotheses.H4_probability_surface: The weighted full candidate remains almost entirely inside [0,1] before clipping and is calibrated under the target action measure without losing calibration-in-the-large under the logged measure.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: All L2d episodes and the L2f result have already been inspected. Passing may select an immutable scorer for wholly fresh confirmation only; it cannot independently confirm, establish causal action value, promote a policy, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no architecture, target, horizon, feature, tree-count, depth, optimizer, regularization, calibration-family, or hyperparameter sweep
no new Wine episode, corpus mutation, history, object encoder, recurrent state, critic, actor, RL, IQL, CQL, long-horizon OPE, active collection, or counterfactual successor

no behavior propensity, baseline identity, lifecycle, stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input; the existing portable shield_action_count feature is unchanged and also defines the uniform target probability
no invented successor for an unexecuted action: weighting only changes the empirical action measure over factual executed transitions
no causal action-effect, long-horizon action-value, HIT-reduction, NMNB, independent-confirmation, or online-execution claim
